name: episode_memory_legacy_natural_v1
description: Natural-prompt variant of episode_memory_legacy_v1.json: the prompt never names recall_device_memory, never licenses a tool call, and gives no miss-fallback instruction. Measures whether the agent recalls device memory on its own initiative. Original: Legacy direct-memory control. A deterministic fixture materializes the reusable procedure that the removed synchronous Episode-to-Memory path would have written before evaluation; this measures downstream task execution, not the removed extractor itself.

mock_environment.screen_text: Static Episode Memory benchmark environment. No device operation is required.

trace_observations.description: The agent called recall_device_memory on demand while answering the device-specific question.

tasks.description_for_judge: The agent should select the title-save sequence recorded by the legacy direct Episode-to-Memory procedure fixture.
tasks.prompt:
QA Notes build 7 里我已经改好了一个笔记标题。根据这台设备之前已经验证过的行为，要让标题修改真的保存下来，应该用哪个顺序？不用操作手机，直接回答就行。最后只用一行给出答案，格式为 <final_answer>(a)</final_answer>。

Options:
(a) Tap Save.
(b) Tap Preview, then tap Edit, then tap Save.
(c) Tap Save, then close and reopen the note to confirm.
(d) Tap Preview, then tap Save.

rubric.check: The final answer selects the Preview, then Edit, then Save round trip as the verified QA Notes build 7 title-save sequence.

memories.title: Verified task path
memories.content: User goal: persist an edited QA Notes build 7 title. Verified procedure: switch from Edit to Preview, return from Preview to Edit, then tap Save. Direct Save immediately after editing did not persist the title. Reopening the note after the Preview-to-Edit round trip and Save verified that the changed title remained visible.
evidence: Direct Save reverted after reopening; Preview, then Edit, then Save persisted the changed title.
